Subject: MAP Draft: Data handling & compliance milestones (PHI/PII, retention, logging)

Hi Emily / Alex —

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation and appreciate you walking us through the clinical integration and regulatory constraints. As discussed, I'm attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v0.3.xlsx) focused on the Data Handling & Compliance milestone so we can align on owners, dependencies, and a target close date.

Key asks for your review on the Data handling milestone:
- Milestone: Confirm acceptable data flows and sign DPA/BAA if PHI is involved
  - Target owner (Customer): Emily Zhao
  - Target owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole / Security (Rishi)
  - Target close: 2026-03-31
  - Dependencies: Security questionnaire, SOC 2 evidence, DPA redlines, deployment mode decision (hosted vs private)

- Milestone: Retention policy and log/audit requirements
  - Proposed: Default 30-day retention for request/response content for hosted customers; configurable up to 7 years for regulated workflows if on Dedicated/Private with BAA
  - Logging: Token-level telemetry available to customer admins; audit trails for admin actions; sampling options for full request logs

Open questions for you:
1) Will Stellar treat model inputs/outputs as PHI for the integration? (you mentioned clinical notes ingestion — want to confirm scope)
2) Any mandatory retention windows we must support for compliance (e.g., 7 years for your audit needs)?
3) Do you require in-region processing (EU/US) or a private deployment for PHI?

Next steps I propose:
- Emily to confirm PHI scope and retention window (reply)
- Redwood to share SOC2 summary and DPA draft (attached)
- Schedule security call (we can do next week) to walk technical controls and logging/audit trail exports

Attach: MAP_v0.3.xlsx

Thanks — I'll loop Rishi and Monica from our side for technical/security details.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Re: MAP Draft: Data handling & compliance milestones (PHI/PII, retention, logging)

Thanks Marissa — quick answers and a few clarifying questions from our side.

1) PHI scope: Yes — patient identifiers + clinical notes we plan to send will be PHI. We need to ensure any storage or logs containing those fields are covered by a BAA.
2) Retention window: Our compliance team typically requires 7 years of retention for audit purposes. That said, we prefer if retention is configurable by dataset and by customer admin.
3) Deployment: Ideally we'd like in-region processing (US) and are open to Dedicated or Private deployment if required for PHI under the BAA.

Can you confirm: do you offer a BAA for hosted customers with PHI, or is Private deployment a hard requirement? Also please share SOC2 and DPA — we'll have legal/security take a look and flag redlines.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short security call next week.

—Emily
Chief Product Officer
Stellar HealthTech
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-02-26T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP Draft: Data handling & compliance milestones (PHI/PII, retention, logging)

Emily — thanks for the quick clarification and the PHI confirmation. Looping Rishi (Security) and Monica (Customer Success) to confirm technical controls and operational options.

Short answers while Rishi looks in:
- BAA: We do provide a BAA. For PHI, our recommended path is Dedicated or Private deployment to give you the strongest isolation and controls; however, we can execute a BAA for hosted under a narrowly scoped contract and additional configurations (encryption, restricted logging, and retention settings).
- Retention: Configurable by customer with default 30 days for hosted; Dedicated/Private supports longer retention windows (up to 7+ years) and can be configured per dataset.
- In-region processing: We support region pinning. US-only processing is available for Dedicated and Private; hosted can be region pinned in some cases depending on availability.

Attached: SOC2-Summary.pdf, DPA-draft.docx for your legal/security review. Rishi — could you confirm encryption at rest, key management options (customer-managed KMS/HSM), and the audit/log exports we can provide for Stellar? And if we need to treat any request/response logs as a separate retention class for PHI, flag that here.

I'll update the MAP and push a new version with specific responsibility rows for Data Handling once we land on the retention + deployment decision.

Best,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: MAP Draft: Data handling & compliance milestones (PHI/PII, retention, logging)

Hi Emily / Marissa —

Short technical summary from Security/Infra:
- Encryption & keys: We support AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit. Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported for Dedicated and Private; for hosted we offer envelope encryption with Redwood-managed KMS and offer key rotation policies.
- Retention: Platform supports configurable retention classes. Default (hosted): 30 days for request/response logs and artifacts. For customers requiring long-term retention (7+ years) or specific audit retention buckets, we recommend Dedicated/Private where retention policies can be applied per dataset and exported to customer-managed archival stores (S3 with lifecycle rules, etc.).
- Logging & audit trails:
  - Admin/action audit trails: full retention configurable and exportable.
  - Request/response logs: can be redacted or sampled; full request logs containing PHI should be treated as high-sensitivity and kept only under explicit agreement (DPA/BAA).
  - Access logs & token telemetry available to customer admins via Console and as periodic exports (CSV/JSON) to customer S3.
- PHI guidance: If Stellar will send PHI, we strongly recommend Dedicated or Private + signed BAA. Hosted BAA can be discussed but will require constraints (e.g., strict retention, logging redaction, and additional contractual controls).

Next steps (security side):
1) Schedule a 45-min security deep-dive call (I'm available Wed/Thu next week PST) — we'll walk controls and evidence (SOC2, pen-test summary, encryption/key options).
2) Legal to review DPA-draft.docx and send redlines (we can accept redline feedback via DocuSign/Share).
3) We'll update MAP to set: Target close 2026-03-31 (pending security call + DPA execution).

Attach: SOC2-Summary.pdf (excerpt), security-evidence-links.txt

Rishi
Head of Security
Redwood Inference
